title: Cartee's Feesh Textures
description: This is a  resource pack for the Blockgame Minecraft server. It helps differentiate the many fish in the server.
body:
### Description
This is a resource pack that gives textures to 30 different custom fish from the Blockgame minecraft server by Pirate Software.

In the base server all the fish use the vanilla textures. There are not enough vanilla fish to have each of these fish have distinct textures of course so we rely on the name when you hover over the item. This pack allows you to see what different fish are without you needing to hover over them in your inventory. 

### Prerequisites
This pack requires the Blockgame Resourcepacks Helper mod made by Bluepanda22. https://modrinth.com/project/94GecYBw

### Credits
This pack was made by Carteecat with help from Pleverr.
